probes.question: In which year was symbolics.com purchased by XF.com Investments?

image.alt: A cream-coloured Symbolics Lisp Machine keyboard with many extra labelled keys such as Hyper, Super and Meta.

body.question: Which of these became the first registered .com domain on 15 March 1985?
body.reveal: symbolics.com became the first (and currently, since it is still registered, the oldest) registered .com domain of the Internet. It was purchased by XF.com Investments in 2009.
